requirements.evidence: Contract signatures match task.md: app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:24, app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:26-32 (named nullable params), app/Actions/SetQueueAccess.php:27-32; enum app/Enums/QueuePermission.php:7 has only `Call = 'call'`. Slug defaults/slugifies (`Str::slug($slug ?? $name)`, CreateQueue.php:32), per-entity uniqueness via `Rule::unique(...)->where('entity_id', ...)` plus `UniqueConstraintViolationException` -> ValidationException in both Create and Update (CreateQueue.php:49-53, UpdateQueue.php:66-71); Update ignores own id (UpdateQueue.php:42). No delete action. SetQueueAccess rejects non-string/unknown entries before any write (lines 36-42), cross-entity -> ValidationException (44-48), empty list deletes and logs revoke only if a row was deleted (61-71), audit context has actor_id/queue_id/entity_membership_id (73-78). Migration has cascading FKs, JSON permissions, unique pair. Policy call() checks manager first, then employee grant with `is_array` guard (QueuePolicy.php:44-66). CallNextTicket authorizes after lock + inactive check (CallNextTicket.php:32); Ticket::call() order lock queue -> inactive -> authorize -> lock ticket -> LogicException (Ticket.php:96-116). Factory builds membership and queue in the same entity (QueueAccessFactory.php:17-22). Docs and CHANGELOG updated.

conventions.evidence: Domain writes live in app/Actions with authorization inside each action via `Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize(...)`; authorization centralized in app/Policies/QueuePolicy.php; model uses `#[Fillable([...])]` like siblings (QueueAccess.php:11); migration has generator-style timestamped name and reversible `down()`; docs/business-rules.md, docs/database-schema.md and CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] Added are updated; audit uses `Log::channel('audit')` per logging guidance.

security.evidence: Every new action authorizes first (CreateQueue.php:26, UpdateQueue.php:34, SetQueueAccess.php:34) and tests prove nothing is written on denial; both call paths now enforce `call` (CallNextTicket.php:32, Ticket.php:107), closing the previous 'any member can call' gap; employee self-grant denied (SetQueueAccess test 'self'); corrupted permissions deny (QueuePolicy.php:65); mass-assignment set deliberately on QueueAccess. No weaknesses found.

tests.evidence: New tests cover each requirement and failure path: tests/Feature/CreateQueueTest.php (roles, trim, slugify, 255 boundary, empty slug, per-entity uniqueness, simulated race, denial for employee/foreign owner/stranger, auth before validation), UpdateQueueTest.php (combinations, no-op, own slug, race, deactivation keeps tickets), SetQueueAccessTest.php (upsert, revoke audit only when row existed, invalid permission datasets, cross-entity, self-grant, cascade), QueuePolicyTest.php (corrupted JSON datasets, grant on other queue), CallNextTicketTest.php (every call mode denies, order inactive vs auth) and IssueTicketTest.php (Ticket::call order). Existing CallNextTicket tests were adapted to use an owner caller (required by the new rule), not weakened. Minor hygiene: `Queue::flushEventListeners()` runs only if the expectation passes and wipes any model-boot listeners.

simplicity.evidence: Lean actions using built-in Validator/Rule::unique/updateOrCreate; shared `memberWithRole` helper in tests/Pest.php. Small extras: the queue row lock in SetQueueAccess.php:57 and UpdateQueue.php:60-64 add transactional machinery beyond what the task asked (defensible for serializing deactivation), and the manager-role check is repeated in QueuePolicy::call instead of reusing `isManagerOf` (QueuePolicy.php:51 vs 69-74).

readability.evidence: Short focused methods with PHPDoc `@throws`, explanatory comments on lock order (Ticket.php:96-97) and race handling (CreateQueue.php:50); consistent naming and sibling style; no dead code or debug output.

scope.evidence: All files serve the task; the only edit outside it is the updated comment in CallNextTicket.php:38-39, which reflects the new Ticket::call() locking. No UI, no extra permissions, no delete action.

issues.explanation: `Queue::flushEventListeners()` is only reached if the expectation passes and also removes any listeners registered in the model's booted(), which can leak into or break later tests in the same process; a try/finally or a scoped listener would be safer.
The owner/admin check in `call()` duplicates the logic in `isManagerOf()` instead of reusing it.
Global helper functions declared inside test files (`gateAllows`, `accessScenario`) risk redeclaration collisions; they belong in tests/Pest.php like `memberWithRole`.
Relies on `User::membershipFor()`, which is not in the diff; assumed to exist in the codebase (it is used by tests too), but could not be verified.

review.summary: The change adds CreateQueue, UpdateQueue and SetQueueAccess actions, the queue_access table/model/factory, the QueuePermission enum and QueuePolicy, and enforces the `call` ability in both CallNextTicket and Ticket::call() in the required order, with docs and CHANGELOG updated. Requirements, security and test coverage are thorough, including race and corrupted-data edge cases. Only minor test-hygiene and small duplication nits remain, so it can be approved with nits.
